proposals.evidence: DEDR5033 gives Tamil mūṭam/mōṭam clouded sky, Malayalam mūṭam, Kannada/Kodagu mōḍa, Tulu mōḍa and Telugu mōḍamu cloudiness. These matching cloud responses preserve length, stop/flap, gemination and final-vowel differences. Minority-lect extensions are comparative proposals, with inheritance versus local transmission pending review; longer rain-cloud compounds are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2552 gives Tamil/Malayalam iravu, irā, rā night, Irula rāvu night, Malayalam iruṭṭu/iriṭṭu darkness, and Kannada iruḷ/iraḷu/iraṭu/irḷu night. The selected simple southern forms match the night/darkness family, including loss of initial i- and final-vowel variants. Darkness-form responses elicited as night retain that survey sense; compound rāpodu-type answers are handled separately. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4616 explicitly gives Tamil makaḷ daughter, Malayalam mōḷ, Kota mōḷ, Kannada magaḷ, Tulu magaḷu, Parji māl and Gadaba māl. The selected survey makaḷ/magaḷ and shortened maka/maga/maha forms are comparative daughter extensions, with southern k/g/h variation and loss of final lateral; Parji/Gadaba māl/malu/melu preserve the separately documented central-Dravidian shape. Source gender/sense and vowel notation are retained; compounds and opaque contractions remain unassigned. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
